tools.name: get_status
tools.title: AutoCAD status
tools.description: Start here. AutoCAD version, open drawings, and for the active drawing: units, current layer/layout/space, entity counts in model space, drawing extents and whether a command is running.

tools.name: get_sysvars
tools.title: Read system variables
tools.description: Read AutoCAD system variables, e.g. INSUNITS, OSMODE, LTSCALE, DIMSCALE, CANNOSCALE, CLAYER.

tools.name: set_sysvar
tools.title: Set a system variable
tools.description: Set one AutoCAD system variable. The value is converted to the variable type (integer, real, string or point).

tools.name: activate_document
tools.title: Switch drawing
tools.description: Make another open drawing the active one (all other tools act on the active drawing). Match by full path, file name, or file name without extension.

document.description: Drawing name or path, see get_status

tools.name: open_document
tools.title: Open drawing
tools.description: Open a .dwg (or .dxf) file in AutoCAD and make it active. If it is already open it is just activated. A name without folder is looked up next to the active drawing (list_drawing_files finds drawings).

path.description: Path of the file (.dwg added when there is no extension)

tools.name: new_document
tools.title: New drawing
tools.description: Create a new drawing from a template (default acadiso.dwt, metric) and make it active. save_as also saves it to a .dwg right away.

template.description: Template file name or path, e.g. acadiso.dwt or acad.dwt

save_as.description: Optional .dwg path to save the new drawing to (must not exist)

tools.name: save_document
tools.title: Save drawing
tools.description: Save the active drawing. No path: save in place. A .dwg path: Save As (the drawing is renamed). A .dxf path: export a DXF copy (the open drawing keeps its name). copy=true with a .dwg path: write a copy and keep working on the original (needs no unsaved changes). version saves in an older format: 2018 (2018-2027), 2013, 2010, 2007, 2004, 2000.

copy.description: Save a copy to path; the open drawing keeps its name (default false)

overwrite.description: copy: replace an existing file at path (default false)

tools.name: close_document
tools.title: Close drawing
tools.description: Close a drawing (default: the active one). Refuses when there are unsaved changes unless save=true or discard_changes=true.

discard_changes.description: Close without saving: unsaved changes are lost

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.title: List layouts
tools.description: Model and paper space layouts (sheets) of the active drawing with tab order, viewport count, paper size and plotter.

tools.name: activate_layout
tools.title: Switch layout
tools.description: Make a layout current (Model or a paper space layout name).

tools.name: list_drawing_files
tools.title: Find drawing files
tools.description: List drawing files in a folder (default: the folder of the active drawing, else Documents), with size, modified time and whether each is open in AutoCAD. Also lists subfolders, to browse before open_document.

folder.description: Folder to list (default: folder of the active drawing)

tools.name: rename_document
tools.title: Rename drawing file
tools.description: Rename a drawing file on disk. An open drawing is closed, renamed and opened again (refused when it has unsaved changes unless save_changes=true). new_name is a file name (same folder) or a full path; the extension stays. Xrefs and sheet sets that point at the old name are not updated.

document.description: Open drawing to rename (name or path, default the active drawing)

path.description: Or: a drawing file on disk

new_name.description: New file name, e.g. A-101.dwg, or a full path

save_changes.description: Save unsaved changes before renaming (default false)

reopen.description: Open the renamed drawing again when it was open (default true)

tools.name: delete_drawing_file
tools.title: Delete drawing file
tools.description: Delete a drawing file (.dwg, .dxf, .dwt, .dws, .bak, .sv$) that is not open. Goes to the Recycle Bin unless permanent=true; on network or removable drives (no Recycle Bin) permanent=true is required.

permanent.description: Delete for good instead of the Recycle Bin (default false)

tools.name: create_layout
tools.title: Create layout
tools.description: Create a paper space layout (sheet), empty or as a copy of another layout (page setup, title block, viewports). Rename / delete layouts with rename_object / delete_object kind=layout.

copy_from.description: Copy this layout (default: new empty layout)

activate.description: Make it the current layout (default false)

tools.name: add_viewport
tools.title: Add viewport
tools.description: Add a viewport to a paper space layout showing part of model space (the layout becomes current). Paper rectangle: corner1 + corner2 in paper units (default: the layout limits, 5% margin). Model area: view_window [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] (fitted) or view_center. scale = paper units per model unit: 0.01 or 1:100.

corner1.description: Paper: first corner of the viewport

view_window.description: Model: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] area to show

view_center.description: Model: point at the viewport center

scale.description: Viewport scale, e.g. 1:100, 1/50 or 0.01 (default: fit view_window or the model extents)

layer.description: Layer for the viewport (created if missing)

tools.name: set_viewport
tools.title: Edit viewport
tools.description: Change a layout viewport (handle from query_entities types=[VIEWPORT] or add_viewport): scale, view_center or view_window (fit), lock, on / off, layer, and per-viewport layer freeze (freeze_layers / thaw_layers, wildcards allowed, like VPLAYER). locked is the state after the call: a locked viewport can change its view with locked=true (stays locked) or false. The viewport layout becomes current.

view_center.description: Model point at the viewport center

view_window.description: Model area [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] to fit (scale from it unless scale is given)

freeze_layers.description: Layers to freeze in this viewport only, wildcards allowed

thaw_layers.description: Layers to thaw in this viewport, wildcards allowed

layer.description: Layer for the viewport (created if missing)

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.title: Export to PDF
tools.description: Plot layouts of the active drawing to PDF (or DWFx / DWF): one multi-sheet file, or one file per layout. Uses each layout page setup; paper, plot_style, area, scale, center and rotation override it. Model space defaults to its extents, fit to the paper. list_options=true lists plotters, paper sizes and plot styles instead.

layouts.description: Layouts to plot, * = every paper layout in tab order, Model = model space (default: the current layout)

path.description: Output file (separate_files: output folder). Default: next to the drawing, named after it

separate_files.description: One file per layout, named DRAWING-LAYOUT (default false: one multi-sheet file)

plotter.description: Plotter .pc3 (default: the page setup one if it makes this format, else DWG To PDF.pc3)

paper.description: Paper size: canonical name or a part of it, e.g. A3, A1, ISO_full_bleed_A1 (default: page setup)

plot_style.description: Plot style table, e.g. monochrome.ctb (default: page setup)

area.description: What to plot (default: page setup; Model: extents)

scale.description: fit, or paper:drawing units like 1:100 (default: page setup; fit when area changes)

list_options.description: Only list plotters, paper sizes (of plotter) and plot styles; plot nothing

tools.name: publish_pdf
tools.title: Publish to PDF
tools.description: Publish layouts of one or more drawings (open, or files on disk) into one multi-sheet PDF (or DWFx / DWF), like PUBLISH. Each sheet uses its own page setup, or page_setup (a named page setup from page_setup_file) for all. Open drawings should be saved first: sheets may come from the file on disk.

drawings.description: Drawing paths or open drawing names (default: the active drawing)

layouts.description: Layout names, wildcards allowed (default * = every paper layout, in tab order)

path.description: Output file (default: next to the first drawing, named after it)

page_setup.description: Named page setup to use for every sheet

page_setup_file.description: Drawing or template that holds page_setup (default: each drawing)

tools.name: list_layers
tools.title: List layers
tools.description: Layers of the active drawing: color, linetype, lineweight, on/off, frozen, locked, plot, current. Xref layers (NAME|LAYER) are skipped unless include_xref=true.

with_counts.description: Also count entities per layer in model and paper space (slower)

tools.name: set_layer
tools.title: Create or edit layer
tools.description: Create a layer (if missing) and/or change it: rename, color, linetype, lineweight, on, frozen, locked, plot, description, make current.

create.description: Create the layer when it does not exist (default true)

color.description: ACI 1-255, color name, #RRGGBB or [r, g, b]

linetype.description: Linetype name (loaded from acadiso.lin if needed)

lineweight.description: Hundredths of a mm, e.g. 25 = 0.25 mm, or Default

tools.name: delete_layer
tools.title: Delete layer
tools.description: Delete an unused layer. With merge_into, first moves every entity on it (including inside block definitions) to that layer.

tools.name: set_text_style
tools.title: Create or edit text style
tools.description: Create a text style (if missing) and/or change it: font (a TrueType typeface like Arial, a .ttf file, or an .shx like romans.shx), bigfont (.shx for Asian text), height (0 = set per text), width_factor, oblique angle, bold / italic (TrueType), rename, make current. Texts using the style update. List with list_named_objects kind=text_style.

create.description: Create the style when it does not exist (default true; it starts as a copy of the current style)

bigfont.description: Big font .shx (SHX fonts only), empty to remove

height.description: Fixed text height, 0 = variable (default 0 for a new style)

make_current.description: Make it the current text style

tools.name: set_dim_style
tools.title: Create or edit dimension style
tools.description: Create a dimension style (copy of base, default the current style) and/or change its DIM variables, e.g. props {DIMSCALE: 100, DIMTXT: 2.5, DIMASZ: 2.5, DIMEXE: 1.25, DIMEXO: 0.625, DIMGAP: 0.625, DIMDEC: 0, DIMTAD: 1, DIMTXSTY: Standard, DIMBLK: _ARCHTICK, DIMCLRD: 1, DIMLUNIT: 2, DIMLFAC: 1}. Dimensions using the style are updated. Read all variables with list_named_objects kind=dim_style full=true.

create.description: Create the style when it does not exist (default true)

base.description: New style: copy settings from this style (default current)

props.description: DIM variables to set: name (DIMTXT or Dimtxt) -> value

make_current.description: Make it the current dimension style

update_dimensions.description: Recompute dimensions that use the style (default true)

tools.name: load_linetype
tools.title: Load linetypes
tools.description: Load linetypes from a .lin file (default acadiso.lin, else acad.lin). names accepts wildcards (DASH*, *). Without names, lists the linetypes in the file and whether each is loaded.

names.description: Linetype names, wildcards allowed (default: only list the file)

file.description: Linetype file name or path (default acadiso.lin)

tools.name: list_named_objects
tools.title: List named objects
tools.description: Named objects of the active drawing by kind: text_style (font, height, width factor), dim_style (main DIM variables, full=true for all), linetype, view, ucs, group (entity handles), mleader_style, table_style, xref (path and status: loaded, unloaded, not_found...). layer, block and layout return the same as list_layers, list_blocks and list_layouts.

full.description: dim_style: every DIM variable; group: every handle (default false)

tools.name: rename_object
tools.title: Rename named object
tools.description: Rename a layer, block, layout, text style, dimension style, linetype, named view, UCS, group, multileader style or table style. Layer 0 / Defpoints, Model, Standard styles, ByLayer / ByBlock / Continuous and xref-dependent names (XREF|NAME) cannot be renamed.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.title: Delete named object
tools.description: Delete named objects of one kind; each name succeeds or fails on its own (results say why). Objects still in use are refused: layer: merge_into moves its entities to another layer first; block: erase_references=true also erases its inserts; layout: Model and the last paper layout stay; group: ungroups (the entities stay). Layer 0, Standard styles and current objects cannot be deleted. Xrefs: manage_xref detach. Unused objects in bulk: purge.

merge_into.description: layer: layer that receives the entities

erase_references.description: block: also erase every insert of the block (default false)

tools.name: purge
tools.title: Purge unused
tools.description: Remove unused named objects like PURGE: blocks, layers, linetypes, text / dimension / multileader / table styles and registered applications (regapp). Repeats for nested items (a purged block can free a layer). dry_run=true only reports.

names.description: Only these names, wildcards allowed (default all)

dry_run.description: Report what would be purged, change nothing (default false)

tools.name: set_group
tools.title: Create or edit group
tools.description: Create a named group of entities (if missing) and/or edit it: add handles, remove_handles, description, selectable. List with list_named_objects kind=group; ungroup with delete_object kind=group (entities stay).

create.description: Create the group when it does not exist (default true)

remove_handles.description: Entities to take out of the group

selectable.description: Selecting one member selects the whole group (default true)

tools.name: import_from_drawing
tools.title: Import from drawing
tools.description: Copy blocks, layers, text / dimension / multileader / table styles or linetypes from another .dwg or .dwt into the active drawing, with what they depend on (a block brings its layers and styles). Objects that already exist are skipped, or redefined with replace=true (every insert of a replaced block changes; run sync_block_attributes if its attributes changed).

names.description: Names to import, wildcards allowed (* = all)

replace.description: Redefine objects that already exist (default false: keep them)

tools.name: query_entities
tools.title: Find entities
tools.description: Find entities in a space (or by handle) with filters, and get their geometry. Returns total_matched, counts_by_type / counts_by_layer and one page of entities (limit/offset). Types are DXF names: LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT (block reference), DIMENSION, HATCH, POINT, SPLINE, ELLIPSE, MULTILEADER, VIEWPORT... Use detail=count to only count, full for color/linetype/bbox/all vertices/length/area/table cells. totals=true adds total_length / total_area of the matches.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

block_names.description: For INSERT: block names (dynamic blocks by their visible name), wildcards allowed

text_contains.description: Keep entities whose text, attribute values or block name contain this (case-insensitive)

colors.description: Keep these colors: ACI number, ByLayer, ByBlock, name or #RRGGBB

linetypes.description: Keep these linetypes (as set on the entity, e.g. ByLayer, DASHED), wildcards allowed

closed.description: Keep only closed (true) or open (false) curves

totals.description: Also sum length and area of the matched entities (default false)

window_mode.description: intersect (default): bounding box overlaps the window; inside: fully inside

tools.name: get_texts
tools.title: Read texts
tools.description: All readable text in a space: TEXT, MTEXT (plain), block attributes (ATTRIB, with block name and tag) and multileader text, with position and height. Good for reading a drawing: room names, labels, title block fields.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.title: List block definitions
tools.description: Block definitions of the active drawing with attribute definitions, entity count, insert count, dynamic/xref flags.

tools.name: selection
tools.title: Get / set selection
tools.description: get: the entities the user has selected (pickfirst). set / add: select these handles in AutoCAD (grips) so the user sees them. clear: deselect.

tools.name: measure
tools.title: Measure
tools.description: Measure in drawing units (WCS). mode: distance {points: chain of 2+ points}; angle {points [vertex, p1, p2] or handles of 2 lines}; area {points polygon, or handles of closed curves / hatches / regions}; length {handles}; bbox {handles}; closest {handles [curve], point}; intersections {handles (2+), extend}.

extend.description: intersections: also where the extended curves would meet (default false)

tools.name: quantity_takeoff
tools.title: Quantity takeoff
tools.description: Count, total length and total area of entities grouped by layer, type and/or block, like a bill of quantities. Length counts curves (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, splines...), area counts closed curves, hatches and regions. length_factor / area_factor convert units (drawing in mm: 0.001 and 0.000001 give m and m2). csv_path also writes a CSV.

space.description: model (default), paper, current, a layout name, or all

block_names.description: For INSERT: block names, wildcards allowed

csv_path.description: Also write the table to this .csv (UTF-8, opens in Excel)

delimiter.description: CSV separator (default ,; use ; for Excel with comma decimals)

tools.name: extract_block_data
tools.title: Extract block data
tools.description: One row per block insert: block, layer, layout, position, rotation, scale, every attribute value (by tag) and dynamic property (dyn:NAME, angles in degrees). Like DATAEXTRACTION; csv_path also writes a CSV for Excel.

block_names.description: Block names, wildcards allowed (default all blocks, xrefs excluded)

space.description: all (default), model, paper, current or a layout name

csv_path.description: Also write the rows to this .csv (UTF-8, opens in Excel)

delimiter.description: CSV separator (default ,; use ; for Excel with comma decimals)

limit.description: Max rows returned in the result (default 500; the CSV gets all)

tools.name: add_entities
tools.title: Draw entities
tools.description: Create entities in one undo step (all or nothing). Each item has a type and its fields; all accept layer (created if missing), color, linetype, lineweight. Types: line {start, end}; polyline {points, closed, bulges, width}; rectangle {corner1, corner2}; circle {center, radius}; arc {center, radius, start_angle, end_angle} or {points: [p1, p2, p3]}; ellipse {center, major_axis [dx, dy], ratio}; point {position}; text {position, text, height, rotation, align (left, center, right, middle_center, top_left...), style}; mtext {position, text (\\n for new line), height, width, rotation, attachment (top_left...), style}; attdef {position, tag, prompt, default, height, rotation, invisible, style} (attribute definition, for create_block); insert {block, position, scale, rotation, attributes {TAG: value}, block_file (a .dwg imported as the block when missing)}; dim_aligned {p1, p2, dim_point, text, style}; dim_linear {p1, p2, dim_point, rotation (0 horizontal, 90 vertical), text, style}; hatch {points (closed polygon) or boundary_handles, pattern (SOLID, ANSI31...), scale, angle}; spline {points}; table {position (top left), rows [[cell...]...], title, header (first row is a header, default true), col_widths (number or list), row_height, text_height, style}; mleader {points [arrow, ..., landing], text, text_height, style}; dim_radius / dim_diameter {handle (circle or arc) + angle, or center + chord_point; leader_length}; dim_angular {center, p1, p2, arc_point}; dim_arc {handle (arc) or center, p1, p2, arc_point}; dim_ordinate {point, leader_end, axis x or y, origin}; dim_chain {points, dim_point, rotation, mode continue or baseline, spacing}. Angles in degrees CCW; height defaults to TEXTSIZE.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

tools.name: update_entities
tools.title: Modify entities
tools.description: Change properties of entities. Either handles + set (same change for all) or items [{handle, ...props}]. Props: layer, color, linetype, lineweight, text, height, rotation, position, start, end, center, radius, closed, width, scale, attributes {TAG: value}, dynamic_props {NAME: value} (dynamic blocks; angles in degrees; lists take one of the allowed values), points + bulges (polyline vertices), cells [{row, col, text}] (tables, 0-based), draw_order (top or bottom). Props that do not apply to an entity type are reported in skipped.

set.description: Properties to apply to every handle

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.title: Delete entities
tools.description: Erase entities by handle (one undo step).

tools.name: transform_entities
tools.title: Move / copy / rotate / scale / mirror
tools.description: Transform entities by handle. operation: move {displacement [dx, dy] or from + to}; rotate {base_point, angle}; scale {base_point, factor}; mirror {mirror_line [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]]}. copy=true transforms copies and returns their handles. Mirror does not keep text readable (MIRRTEXT is not applied).

copy.description: Transform copies instead of the originals

tools.name: create_block
tools.title: Make block
tools.description: Create a block definition from existing entities (all from the same space). mode: convert (default) replaces them with a block reference, keep leaves them, delete erases them.

tools.name: explode_entities
tools.title: Explode
tools.description: Explode entities into their parts in the same space: block inserts, polylines, dimensions, multiline text, hatches, regions... Block attributes become plain text with their values (attributes_as_text, default true; false = like EXPLODE, attribute definitions showing the tags). Returns the new handles.

attributes_as_text.description: Block inserts: turn attribute values into text (default true)

tools.name: replace_text
tools.title: Find and replace text
tools.description: Find and replace in TEXT, MTEXT, block attribute values, dimension text overrides, multileader text and table cells (one undo step). Plain text by default, regex=true for regular expressions ($1 in replace). dry_run=true only counts and shows samples. Entities on locked layers are skipped and counted; an MTEXT whose formatting splits the match is reported, not changed.

find.description: Text to find (or a regular expression with regex=true)

regex.description: find is a .NET regular expression (default false)

space.description: all (default), model, paper, current or a layout name

include_blocks.description: Also change text inside block definitions (default false)

dry_run.description: Count and show samples only (default false)

tools.name: edit_geometry
tools.title: Offset / join / boundary
tools.description: Geometry edits. offset {handles (curves), distance, side_point (which side) or both=true}; join {handles: lines, arcs, polylines touching end to end, joined into one polyline (or splines into a spline)}; boundary {point inside a closed area, islands} creates the closed polyline(s) around it, like BOUNDARY: the area must be visible on screen (zoom first). New entities are returned with their length / area.

side_point.description: offset: a point on the side to offset to

point.description: boundary: a point inside the area

islands.description: boundary: detect islands inside the area (default true)

layer.description: Layer for the new entities (default: as the source / current layer)

tools.name: sync_block_attributes
tools.title: Sync block attributes
tools.description: Like ATTSYNC: make every insert of the blocks match the block definition attributes. Missing attributes are added with their default value, existing values are kept, attributes no longer in the definition are removed (remove_extra), and position / style / height follow the definition unless keep_positions=true. Inserts on locked layers are skipped.

keep_positions.description: Keep the position and look of existing attributes (default false)

remove_extra.description: Remove attributes whose tag is not in the definition (default true)

tools.name: attach_xref
tools.title: Attach xref
tools.description: Attach (or overlay) a .dwg as an external reference and insert it. The path is stored relative to this drawing when relative_path=true and both are on the same drive.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

overlay.description: Overlay instead of attach: not seen when this drawing is itself referenced (default false)

layer.description: Layer for the xref insert (created if missing)

tools.name: manage_xref
tools.title: Manage xrefs
tools.description: Act on attached xrefs by name (see list_named_objects kind=xref): detach (remove it and all its inserts), reload, unload, bind (make it a normal block, names become XREF$0$NAME), insert (bind with plain names), repath (new_path, then reload).

tools.name: zoom
tools.title: Zoom
tools.description: Zoom the current view: extents (everything), window {p1, p2}, handles (fit these entities), or center {center, height}.

height.description: center: view height in drawing units

margin.description: Extra space around the target, as a fraction (default 0.05)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: PNG image of the current AutoCAD view of the active drawing, to check what was drawn. Zoom first to frame the area.

save_path.description: Also save the PNG to this path

tools.name: save_view
tools.title: Save named view
tools.description: Save the current view (or the window p1, p2) as a named view of the current space. replace=true overwrites one with the same name. List with list_named_objects kind=view; rename / delete with rename_object / delete_object kind=view.

replace.description: Overwrite an existing view with this name (default false)

tools.name: restore_view
tools.title: Restore named view
tools.description: Show a saved named view. A paper space view needs its layout to be current, a model view needs Model (or a viewport).

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run AutoCAD command
tools.description: Send a command line to AutoCAD as if typed, e.g. _.ZOOM _E, -LAYER _M WALL  (spaces = Enter), _.PURGE _A * _N, _.OVERKILL. Use command-line versions (-LAYER, -INSERT, -HATCH) so no dialog opens. Waits until the command finishes (or wait_seconds) and reports entities created meanwhile. Commands that repeat prompts (LINE, PLINE) need an extra Enter (two spaces) to end. A command still waiting for input when the wait ends is cancelled (Esc) unless cancel_unfinished=false, so AutoCAD is not left busy. AutoLISP expressions and commands that load code, run scripts or start programs are refused.

command.description: Command line text. Prefix with _. for English command names

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the command to finish (default 15, max 120)

cancel_unfinished.description: Press Esc if the command is still waiting for input at the end (default true)

echo.description: Echo on the AutoCAD command line (default true)

tools.name: cancel_command
tools.title: Cancel running command
tools.description: Press Esc in the active drawing to cancel the running command. Use it for a command run_command left open, or when the user agrees to cancel what they are doing: other write tools refuse to run while a command is active.

tools.name: reload_addin
tools.title: Reload add-in
tools.description: Reload T3LabCAD.Core.dll from the bundle folder after installing a new build (scripts/install.ps1). The connection drops for a moment; call get_status after a few seconds.
